_comment: Golden fixture (#1804): the sorted set of `env` keys `nightgauge opencode config --json` prints for the reference machine config (openCodeVerbMachineConfig, lmstudio/qwen/qwen3.8-27b) and a bare `--stage feature-dev --worktree <repo> --run-id <id>` invocation, with no operator-install-risk directory present. TestOpenCodeConfigVerbEnvKeysMatchGoldenFixture (cmd/nightgauge/opencode_test.go) regenerates this list from the real verb and fails the Go build if it drifts; tests/cli/childEnv.test.ts reads this same file and asserts every key is accepted by the TS allowlist (isOpenCodeRunEnvAccepted), so a variable InstallNightgaugePlugin or OpenCodeIsolationEnv starts setting cannot silently ship without the TS side admitting it. NIGHTGAUGE_OPENCODE_OPERATOR_INSTALL_RISK is deliberately absent here (it only appears when an operator's OpenCode install directory is at risk) and is covered by its own dedicated accept-but-withhold tests instead.
